normalize_probability_distribution: normalize a dictionary of probability values so they sum to one
sample_from_probability_dict: sample a key from a probability dictionary using numpy random choice
sample_from_probability_list: sample an index from a list of probabilities using manual iteration
sample_from_joint_policy: sample an action from a joint policy list of tuples with probabilities
argmax_probability_dict: find the key with the maximum probability value in a dictionary
